feature_brief.title: Normalize Text
feature_brief.outcome: One local file yields normalized text or an evidenced deterministic error.
scope_in: Normalize one local UTF-8 text file using Python standard library only.
Strip ASCII spaces and tabs from each line edge; preserve interior whitespace and every logical blank line, including trailing blank lines.
Convert CRLF and CR to LF; empty input produces empty output; nonempty input gains a terminating LF only when normalized output lacks one, preserving all existing trailing LF characters.
Read exactly one file path and emit normalized UTF-8 to stdout. Invalid UTF-8, missing files, and directories exit 2 with concise stderr and no stdout.

evidence.setup_provenance: Independently constructed pristine target; not evidence of prior SelectFeature execution.
